title: Oladapo Akinyemi is a dedicated and accomplished individual known for his hard work and commitment to excellence. His educational journey began at Ansaru-deen Primary School and continued through various institutions, culminating in a Master's degree in Forestry with a focus on Forest Economics and Management. Currently pursuing a Ph.D. in the same field, Oladapo has held several significant positions in academia, including Head of Department and Acting Provost at the Federal College of Forestry Mechanization. He has contributed extensively to research, with numerous publications and conference papers. A member of several professional organizations, he is recognized for his leadership and commitment to education. Oladapo is also a devoted Christian and family man, married with children.
